test-sequence.title: 1 / Task contract
test-sequence.detail: The domain owner requires rejection of negative payment amounts.

test-sequence.title: 2 / Request context
test-sequence.detail: The runtime requests only approved contract and test patterns.

test-sequence.title: 3 / Scoped context
test-sequence.detail: The policy boundary returns versioned permitted evidence.

test-sequence.title: 4 / Candidate test
test-sequence.detail: The runtime submits a candidate and a requested runner.

test-sequence.title: 5 / Authorize sandbox
test-sequence.detail: Authorization is checked before any tool runs.

test-sequence.title: 6 / Independent test
test-sequence.detail: The original passes and the seeded faulty behavior fails.

test-sequence.title: 7 / Evidence bundle
test-sequence.detail: Checks, versions and artifact digest go to the reviewer.

test-sequence.title: 8 / Human decision
test-sequence.detail: Existing repository controls govern approval and merge.

gateway-sequence.title: 1 / Attempt production write
gateway-sequence.detail: The sandbox-only task requests an unauthorized resource.

gateway-sequence.title: 2 / Evaluate policy
gateway-sequence.detail: The gateway checks identity, scope and approval before execution.

gateway-sequence.title: 3 / Record denial
gateway-sequence.detail: Persist reason and policy version. The tool is never invoked.

gateway-sequence.title: 4 / Return denied
gateway-sequence.detail: Stop this action; escalate through a separate authorized workflow.

fallback-state.title: 1 / Contain
fallback-state.detail: A breach or outage stops consequential agent actions.

fallback-state.title: 2 / Route to fallback
fallback-state.detail: Use the approved manual queue or last validated service.

fallback-state.title: 3 / Recovery review
fallback-state.detail: Validate the fix and exercise the original failure case.

fallback-state.title: 4 / Authorized resumption
fallback-state.detail: An owner authorizes normal service. Reconcile prior side effects separately.

failure-resolution.title: 1 / Failure → triage
failure-resolution.detail: Capture CI traces, fixture versions and repeatability evidence.

failure-resolution.title: 2 / Repair branch
failure-resolution.detail: An owner confirms the cause and requests a product, test, data or environment repair.

failure-resolution.title: 3 / Independent retest
failure-resolution.detail: Reproduce the original failure, verify the repair and run relevant regression cases.

failure-resolution.title: Quarantine branch
failure-resolution.detail: Only a confirmed flaky test can enter a time-limited exception with replacement coverage.

failure-resolution.title: 4 / Repair evidence
failure-resolution.detail: Retain the verified outcome, reviewer and versions.

failure-resolution.title: 3 / Open exception record
failure-resolution.detail: Keep the owner, expiry, repair ticket and coverage plan. Recheck until the test is restored.
